description: MaalingRespFrekvens normally produces an integer Observation. Here Vaerdi='ikke maalbar' is unparseable as integer. Datatype mismatch must fail at row-level, not batch-level, and be logged with aktivitet id, element id, SFI-code and raw value.

routing.rationale: Aktivitetstype MaalingRespFrekvens er positive listed til Observation.

notes: Ingen Observation maa udsendes for denne raekke. Naboraekker i samme batch skal stadig producere output.
Observation-builderen skal fejle stoette pr. aktivitetsresultat; SFI_datapoint maa ikke faa partial rows.
